schema_documentation:
6 top-level keys, one single key-set across all 843 records I parsed (stats json: 355/355 same key set).

| key | type | presence | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | str | 100% | Full document in Markdown (PDF→MD pipeline). ONLY training field. |
| `doc_id` | str, 64 hex | 100% | SHA-256; 354/354 distinct in one sample, 0 exact-duplicate texts |
| `chunk_id` | int | 100% | **0 in all 842 records checked** — no chunking |
| `filename` | str, 7 ch | 100% | e.g. `AAA_032` |
| `source_metadata` | **dict** | 100% | 10 sub-keys, scraped bibliographic — SEE WARNING |
| `pipeline_metadata` | **dict** | 100% | 33 sub-keys of computed quality signals — aligned & trustworthy |

`source_metadata` sub-keys: `collection_slug` (str, 12 values: IKEE_AUT 135, ntua 51, hellanicus 46, Dione 41, Pandemos 24, ekke 15, KEIED 11, elocus 11, deltion 8, elstat 6, helios 5, anaktisis 1 of 354), `filename` (`AAA_032.pdf`), `filename_base`, `language_code` (`ELL` 209 / `NONE` 145), `type` (17 values: thesis 200, article 33, άρθρο 22, συνέδριο 20, book 18, text 14, κεφάλαιο 11…), `page_number` (int), `title_all_english` (bool), `metadata_num_fields` (int), **`metadata_json` (str → json.loads → dict)**, **`pdf_links_json` (str, NOT JSON)**.

`pipeline_metadata` sub-keys (all 100%): `filter` (`ok` 354/354), `is_duplicate` (False 354/354), `is_empty` (False 354/354), `needs_ocr` (False 354/354), `ocr_success` (True 89 / False 265 = 25.1% OCR'd), `download_success` (True 354/354), `processing_stage` (`download,extract` 272 / `download,extract,clean` 82), `percentage_greek`, `latin_percentage`, `greek_badness_score`, `mojibake_badness_score`, `polytonic_ratio`, `char_count_no_comments`, `page_count`/`pages_total`, `pages_with_formula`, `formula_total`, `formula_avg_pp`, `formula_p90_pp`, `math_enriched`, `math_items`, `math_accepted`, `math_accept_rate`, `math_time_sec`, `quality_method`, `reevaluated_at`, plus always-empty `url`, `download_error`, `duplicate_of`, `phase_recommended`, `mojibake_latin_percentage` (null 355/355), `download_retry_count` (0.0).
semantic_meaning: Full-text Greek academic PDFs (theses, articles, books, chapters) from ~12 Greek open-access institutional repositories, converted to Markdown.
split_group_rule: Hash originating source identity; dictionary group by normalized lemma; recipes by normalized recipe title conservatively across ingredient variants; sentiment by complete normalized review content. Global duplicate components must share a split.
validation_rules: Rebuild full user prompt and answer from preserved evidence
Independent Greek grammar/naturalness review remains mandatory
Verified license and privacy clearance required for release
